text: Current sink cleanup scans only Partial messages, reads the mailbox UIDL/account data and retains records for the current account. It deletes a DB header only after protocol CheckMessage says that UIDL is absent, then notifies deletion if any header was removed. Do not infer stale-message status from a different account or a selected download that lacks the full server list. No cleanup reproduction was run. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Scope POP3 stale partial cleanup to the matching account and server evidence
